dead_ends: Reactome containedEvents is shallow (no inputs/outputs): one query + one participants call per reaction is needed, plus one per catalyst activity
The old WikiPathways webservice is retired; the static JSON index + GPML assets are used instead
merge_risks_seen: State names never agree between a paper and a database, so a state-name match would never merge. Round 0 merged state-blind (wrong join across compartments possible); round 1 applies VD-13: compartments folded (GO id or synonym table), different places kept apart and counted kept_apart_compartment. Remaining risk: the synonym table is small, so unlisted spellings of one place stay apart (under-merge, duplicates shown)

Database currency spellings ('Hydrogen Ion', 'Water', 'Adenosine triphosphate') are not in payload.CURRENCY: without the id-based rename they would join identity sets (no merge) and carry hop edges (wrong hops). Round 0 also suffixed charged forms ('ATP [reactome]') into a non-currency hub; fixed by F1
Reactome uses charged ChEBI forms (ATP(4-) 30616) where papers ground neutral ones (15422): id match fails, name match may still join; a name match with conflicting ChEBI is renamed and shows twice

Complexes carry no ids: two different complexes with one name would join by name; convert joins by UniProt member set and renames on clash. Reactome complexes are flattened to their UniProt members (sets inside complexes not distinguished)
Reactome catalyst sets (DefinedSet) are written as alternative single-protein enzymes, not one complex
VD-11 (note a): a DB step that adds only H+ or H2O to a paper step stays separate; counted by report.currency_only_twins (unit test shows the case; live count pending)
